thread:
marta: Hey team — can someone give quick eyes on PR #8342? Ran a canary against longseq workload and seeing a p95 bump + memory delta. Link to bench: https://bench.redwood/internal/8342-results :eyes:

liam: On it. can you paste the bench numbers here?

marta: Sure — short paste below. This is the canary vs main on 4k sequence, 16 batch

```
Before (main): p50=28ms p95=112ms p99=210ms RSS=12.3GB
After (pr-8342): p50=30ms p95=145ms p99=235ms RSS=12.5GB
Delta: p95 +33ms (+29%), RSS +200MB
```

marta: Also attaching the run id: run-20260315-19:22 and the artifacts pinned on the bench link. The PR touches allocator placement heuristics and a small prefetch change.

sophia: Hmm that p95 jump is notable. Any repro on smaller batch or shortseq?

marta: Shortseq (512) looks unchanged. Microbench shows no regression for small batches. This seems longseq-specific and only shows up in the canary under sustained tails.

srinivas: If it's allocator placement + prefetch, could be extra lock contention for long KV chains. Do we have flame graphs?

marta: Yes — I uploaded a few flame snapshots to the bench page. TL;DR: a hotspot at allocator::assign_shard_for_prefetch() where it spins on a global map for some requests.

liam: Could that be mitigated by moving the map to sharded map or using per-worker cache?

marta: I prototyped a per-worker cache in the branch, but trades memory for fewer contends. I left it configurable (env var) so we can A/B.

ci-bot: Canary deploy finished: 4 nodes, 10k requests, failure rate 0.0%, avg throughput 1.2k r/s.

sophia: Thanks. Marta — can you add a quick microbench that toggles the env config and show p95 with config on/off? That will help decide rollback vs config flip.

marta: Yep — will push results in ~40m. If anyone can give +1 for a config toggle as temporary mitigation, would appreciate it. I want to avoid a hard revert if config fixes it quickly.

liam: I can give a +1 for a config-based mitigation after we see the toggled bench. If it drops p95 back near main, we flip and file follow-up to refactor the map.

sophia: Same here. Also assign an owner to the follow-up refactor please.

marta: Assigned to me for the follow-up (PR #8399). Will post bench output shortly. :thumbsup:

(40 minutes later)

marta: microbench with per-worker cache enabled:

```
Per-worker ON: p50=29ms p95=118ms p99=220ms RSS=12.9GB
Per-worker OFF: p50=30ms p95=147ms p99=236ms RSS=12.5GB
```

marta: So p95 drops ~20-30ms (close to main) but RSS increases ~400MB vs main. Tradeoff looks acceptable for a short mitigation window.

liam: Good signal. I'll approve the config toggle on the canary flag. Can you open a one-line patch to make the config default off and gated by rollout flag? We'll flip on canary first.

marta: Opening config flip PR now, will link it here. https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/8351

sophia: Once PR 8351 is up, let's run a quick canary with the flag on for 1 hour and monitor p95 and memory. If stable, roll to 50% then full.

srinivas: Also add a small regression alert to the SLO dashboard for p95 > 130ms for longseq so we catch any regressions post-rollout.

marta: Added alert and dashboard tile. Thanks all for quick eyes. Closing for now; will DM if anything funky shows up during canary flip. :wave:
